proposals.before: Yu Shiji, style Yongzhen, came from Xiangshan. During Jianwen he was training instructor at Yanzhou. After submitting a memorial on current policy, he was promoted to censor. Sent to inspect Fengyang, Huizhou, and Huguang, he distinguished and released wrongfully imprisoned men. When Chengzu took the throne, Yu was advanced to assistant censor-in-chief. By imperial order he carried books on water management to Yuanji, and he stayed on to supervise agricultural administration in western Zhejiang. Huzhou owed as much as six hundred thousand shi of grain, and his colleagues wanted to report a reduced figure. Shiji said, "To deceive the ruler and harm the people is something I will not do." He reported the facts in full, and all the arrears were remitted. Soon afterward he was impeached by Censor-in-chief Chen Ying and imprisoned together with Yuan Fu, vice minister of the Court of Judicial Review. Yuan Fu died in prison, and Shiji was demoted to managing official and assigned to water control in Suzhou and Songjiang. Later he was restored to office. On his return he submitted the Shengxiao ruiying song. The emperor said, "You are a great minister, yet instead of speaking of the people's benefits and harms, you offer flattery?" and threw it back to him. Early in Xuande, Shiji reached the post of vice minister in the Nanjing Ministry of Justice and retired.

proposals.before: Yu Shiji, style Yongzhen, was from Xiangshan. During Jianwen he served as training instructor at Yanzhou. He submitted a letter discussing current policy and was promoted to censor. Sent out to inspect Fengyang, Huizhou, and Huguang, he was able to distinguish and release wrongful imprisonments. When Chengzu came to the throne, he was advanced to assistant censor-in-chief. Under imperial order, he took books on water management and bestowed them on Yuanji, and therefore remained to supervise agricultural administration in western Zhejiang. Huzhou owed as much as six hundred thousand shi of grain; his colleagues wanted to reduce the number in reporting it. Shiji said, "To deceive the ruler and harm the people is something I will not do." He fully memorialized the truth, and all were exempted. Soon he was impeached by Chen Ying, censor-in-chief, and was imprisoned together with Yuan Fu, vice minister of the Court of Judicial Review. Fu died in prison, and Shiji was demoted to managing official and put to work on water control in Suzhou and Songjiang. Later he was restored to office, and on returning submitted the Shengxiao ruiying song. The emperor said, "You are a great minister, yet instead of speaking of the people's benefits and harms, you present flattery?" He threw it back to him. At the beginning of Xuande, Shiji served up to vice minister of the Nanjing Ministry of Justice and retired.
proposals.after: Yu Shiji, style Yongzhen, was from Xiangshan. During Jianwen he served as training instructor at Yanzhou. He submitted a letter discussing current policy and was promoted to censor. Under imperial order, he took books on water management and bestowed them on Yuanji, and therefore remained to supervise agricultural administration in western Zhejiang. Huzhou owed as much as six hundred thousand shi of grain; his colleagues wanted to reduce the number in reporting it. Shiji said, "To deceive the ruler and harm the people is something I will not do." He fully memorialized the truth, and all were exempted. Soon he was impeached by Chen Ying, Censor-in-Chief, and was imprisoned together with Yuan Fu, Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review. Fu died in prison, and Shiji was demoted to managing official and put to work on water control in Suzhou and Songjiang. Later he was restored to office, and on returning submitted the Shengxiao ruiying song. The emperor said, "You are a great minister, yet instead of speaking of the people's benefits and harms, you present flattery?" He threw it back to him.
